trackTitle: CBSE Class XII Computer Science (Subject Code: 083) Complete Mastery
description: An exhaustive, exam-aligned master curriculum for CBSE Class XII Computer Science (Code 083) as prescribed by CBSE (2024-25 / 2025-26 / 2026-27). Covers Unit I: Computational Thinking and Programming - 2 (40 Marks) including functions, scope (LEGB), text/binary/CSV file handling, pickle module, csv module, linear data structures, and Stack (LIFO) operations; Unit II: Computer Networks (10 Marks) covering evolution, transmission media, devices, topologies, protocols, web services, cybersecurity, and 4-mark case study layout designs; Unit III: Database Management (20 Marks) featuring relational database concepts, keys, SQL DDL/DML commands, table constraints, aggregate functions, GROUP BY, HAVING, multi-table Equi-Joins, and Python-MySQL database connectivity using mysql.connector; and Segment 7: Examination Mastery with Solved Board Sample Papers and a Complete 20+ Program Practical Laboratory Repository.

subject: Computer Science (083)

prerequisites: Completion of CBSE Class XI Computer Science (Code 083) or equivalent foundational Python programming
Familiarity with data types, loops, conditionals, and standard library modules
Access to a computer with Python 3.10+ and MySQL 8.0+ installed

unit1.unitName: Unit I: Computational Thinking and Programming - 2 (Python)
unit1.description: Revision of Class XI Python, functions, scope of variables (LEGB), parameter passing mechanics, default arguments, text file handling, binary file handling with pickle, CSV file handling with csv module, linear data structures, and Stack (LIFO) operations using Python lists.

unit2.description: Evolution of networking (ARPANET, NSFNET, Internet), data communication terminologies, transmission media (guided and unguided), network devices, topologies (Star, Bus, Tree, Mesh), network categories (PAN, LAN, MAN, WAN), network protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, VoIP, etc.), web services, cybersecurity threats & defenses, and 4-mark case-study network layout designs.

unit3.description: Database concepts, relational data model, candidate/primary/foreign keys, SQL DDL/DML statements, table constraints, aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX), GROUP BY and HAVING clauses, two-table Equi-Joins, and Python-MySQL database connectivity using mysql.connector.
